cells.tense: The giving is public now, and the room is standing in it with you.
cells.act: tend the resource with responsible care
cells.ask: Pick the tradition or role you look after here, and put a regular hour on it. Keep it where the group can count on finding it.
cells.core:
What you gave up, the group has seen, and the room is still holding it up. You can stand in the middle of that without managing it. The credit isn't as fragile as you sometimes brace for it to be — it's doing what credit does when a group means it. You can hold that and keep working at the same time.
The steady part is that you keep tending. You look after the rituals and the shared ways of doing things because you're the kind of person who stays near them, and the room can lean on that. That care is real and it isn't thin. Give it to the specific thing you keep, not to a whole crowd's needs at once. Care holds when it has a shape.
cells.sheetLine: The room saw what you gave, and it's still holding it.
cells.verb: waiting for what you gave up to come back around as visible credit
cells.place: among the ones who keep the meaning and carry it forward together

cells.tense: You are already past the thank-you, building the next sacrifice in your head.
cells.act: sort what matters from what does not, carefully
cells.ask: Before you take on anything new here, put the whole list on paper once. Cross off what isn't yours to carry, and sit with whatever remains.
cells.core:
Something you gave up is being counted now, and the counting has turned into a running tally you keep privately. You want it to land in the right shape, to be the right size — and that appetite has run out farther than the thing itself. You've started paying the next sacrifice in your mind before anyone asked for it. The room can't feel a gift that's already spent on the version you're imagining.
More discipline won't fix this; closer eyes will. Refining what you can actually tell apart — the thing you're doing from the thing people are thanking you for — is fine work and you're built for it. Sit still with the list and work one distinction until it's clean.
cells.sheetLine: You're paying the next sacrifice before anyone asked.

cells.tense: What you gave is still unsettled, and you have stopped standing in the middle of this room.
cells.act: persist on your own reserves through the pressure
cells.ask: Hold your own footing. Do the thing you know how to keep, and don't check whether the group notices what it costs.
cells.core:
You gave something up and the account is still unsettled. You hold the tradition here, the way things are done, and you do it standing half a step outside the middle of it. The room is still yours; you've just moved your weight off it.
You don't have to force the room to feel it. That isn't the job. You have reserves, and they hold under weight — use them on your own footing, the thing you know how to keep, kept. A held thing stays held. Your full weight comes back in time, and the place doesn't have to be earned back.

cells.tense: You keep the shared meaning steady here, and it runs without your watching it.
cells.ask: Hand a piece of what you keep to someone else — chosen for what they'd carry well, not for what they'd do with it.
cells.core:
You are carrying the shared thing — the way this group does it, the meanings it keeps — and because nothing about it asks to be credited, you don't count it as carrying. The group leans on it and would feel it the day you set it down, but that day sits on no calendar here. The work is real. It's the ledger that's thin.
Tending a shared thing on purpose looks like this: name one piece of it and hand that piece to someone, along with the trust that naming gives them. Nothing else about the day changes. When someone else holds a part, the whole keeps even while you step back, and you learn which parts were yours and which were not. Keep at it. The grip is what you set down.
cells.sheetLine: You keep the shared thing going, and you don't count it.
cells.verb: waiting for what you gave up to come back around as visible credit
cells.place: among the ones who keep the meaning and carry it forward together
